messages:
Jess (Support): FYI, customer Acme reported ~6 hours of tenant usage missing in the console. They see zeros for hourly rows 02:00-08:00 UTC. Not a tenant-wide outage, only metrics/usage in console.

Jess (Support): They said this started after an automated auth key rotation we did at 01:45 UTC. Customer claims they had active requests during window.

Miguel (SRE): Investigating. Do we know if ingesters accepted events? Any spikes/consumer lag?

Aria (Analytics): Looking at pipeline: staging topic has messages for that tenant. Downstream hourly rollup table shows no writes for those hours. Could be CDC/consumer stop or a schema mismatch error swallowed by the pipeline.

Tom (Data Eng): Running quick check on consumer groups for analytics-ingest. Output:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group analytics-staging
TOPIC         PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG   CONSUMER-ID
usage-events     3         124500         124500         0    consumer-xyz
usage-events     4         0              3500          3500  consumer-analytics-1
```
Tom (Data Eng): Partition 4 shows lag and current-offset 0. That looks like consumer restarted and didn't pick up.

Miguel (SRE): Can we correlate with service logs? Any auth failures around 01:45?

Aria (Analytics): Found errors in pipeline logs: "UnhandledRecordError: schema not found for version null" and repeated auth failures from the CDC connector at 01:47. Connector logs: token refresh failed, connector entered FAILED state and did not auto-restart.

Jess (Support): So connector failed after auth rotation and left a gap in processed messages. Customer requests timeline + ETA for repair / backfill.

Tom (Data Eng): Plan: 1) Resume/replace CDC connector to catch live events. 2) Run targeted reprocess for partition 4 for the tenant/time window. I can run backfill job with id backfill-198765. Need approval to reprocess ~1.2M messages (expected 2-4 hours).

Miguel (SRE): I've restarted the connector with rotated creds, monitor logs now. If it stays up I'll tail offsets.

deploy-bot: Connector analytics-cdc restarted by Miguel at 02:35 UTC — health checks passing.

Miguel (SRE): After restart, consumer now progressing: partition 4 lag decreasing from 3500 -> 1200 in 30m. Good sign.

Aria (Analytics): However, the rollup task also had a schema strictness flag that caused any record missing field 'tenant_env' to be dropped quietly. That flag was turned on in a recent config change (config PR #342). Some older messages from before rotation lacked that field, so they were filtered.

Tom (Data Eng): For full recovery we need to: 1) reprocess trimmed messages with a compatibility mapping (fill default tenant_env), 2) run backfill for the hourly rollup for tenant across 01:00-09:00 UTC. Backfill job will populate missing hourly rows.

Jess (Support): Communicated to customer: we've recovered live ingestion and scheduled a backfill. Offered to put them on an update cadence: 30m until backfill starts, then hourly status. They accepted.

Aria (Analytics): Backfill prerequisites done: mapping ready, safe reprocess tested on staging with the same tenant — results match expected counts. Backfill scheduled to start at 03:10 UTC. Estimated duration 3-5 hours depending on downstream write throughput.

Tom (Data Eng): Kickoff: starting backfill job backfill-198765 now. Monitoring writes to hourly_rollups.

Miguel (SRE): Monitoring for duplicates/overwrites. Enable idempotency flag on writes.

Jess (Support): Notified customer that console will reflect data progressively as hours complete. Also flagged billing team to ignore any charge variance alerts during patch window.

Tom (Data Eng): Backfill progress update: 20% done — 01:00-03:00 windows complete and visible in console for the tenant.

Jess (Support): Customer responded: "Thanks — seeing 01-03 now, appreciate the quick turnaround." :thumbsup:

Aria (Analytics): Postmortem notes so far: auth rotation triggered connector failure (no auto-restart), recent strict schema flag caused silent drops, lack of consumer-alerting for long-running connector FAILED state.

Miguel (SRE): Action items: add connector health monitors + alert, ensure auto-restart policy enabled, review auth-rotation playbook to include connector restarts.

Tom (Data Eng): Action items: add schema-compatibility test in CI for rollup task, add backfill automation for small windows.

Jess (Support): Closing loop with customer after backfill finishes. Will file an incident and link this thread.

Tom (Data Eng): Backfill complete at 06:22 UTC. Console shows all missing hours restored. Final counts match expected ingestion totals.

Jess (Support): Customer confirmed full recovery at 06:30 UTC. Marking support ticket resolved. :white_check_mark:

Miguel (SRE): Leaving follow-up incident/investigation notes in ops-docs and assigning owners.

Aria (Analytics): I'll draft postmortem and include the repro steps and mitigations.

Jess (Support): Great — thanks everyone for the quick coordination.
